subject: Thank You for Joining W.E. Build Demo Day 2025
snippet:
Thank you for joining us—whether in person or virtually—for this year’s
 W.E. Build Demo Day. Your presence helped make the evening a powerful
 celebration of our Cohort 3 founders, who are now among the 27 to
